compiled_consensus.label: Compiled consensus
compiled_consensus.definition: A published compilation of independent forecasters' numbers for the release, maintained by an official body. The closest thing in the catalogue to the consensus figure printed on an economic calendar.
compiled_consensus.produced_by: many independent forecasters, aggregated by a publisher

forecaster_survey.label: Forecaster survey
forecaster_survey.definition: An official survey of professional forecasters, market participants, or the publisher's own business and household expectations panel. A real consensus of opinion, but on the survey's own horizon and cadence, which is often quarterly or annual rather than one reading per release.
forecaster_survey.produced_by: surveyed forecasters, aggregated by the surveying institution

market_implied.label: Market implied
market_implied.definition: Derived from traded instrument prices, usually options or futures. It reflects what the market is priced for, not what any person forecast.

model_nowcast.label: Model nowcast
model_nowcast.definition: A statistical model's estimate of the current period, published and maintained by a central bank or reserve bank. Updated continuously as inputs arrive; no human forecast is involved.

central_bank_projection.label: Central-bank projection
central_bank_projection.definition: A central bank's own published projection for the variable, from a monetary policy report, staff projection round or equivalent official publication.

institutional_projection.label: Institutional projection
institutional_projection.definition: A projection published by a multilateral or national institution that is not the currency's central bank, such as the IMF or the OECD. Typically annual and revised a few times per year.

fxmacrodata.label: FXMacroData forecast
fxmacrodata.definition: An FXMacroData-generated estimate combining central-bank guidance, survey consensus, historical trends and recent prints. It is our number, not a market consensus, and must never be presented as one.

access.note: This coverage catalogue is free and needs no API key. Forecast values themselves require a plan on every currency, USD included. Which publishers cover a pair is set by the publisher, not by your plan: no subscription adds a source that is not listed here.

notes.external_prediction_source_count: Counts outside publishers whose forecasts are aligned to this indicator's own release schedule and served in the data array. It excludes fxmacrodata_blended, our own model, which covers every confirmed release row and so would make every indicator look covered.
notes.official_forecast_sources: Publishers carried for this currency on their own periods and units -- quarterly averages, annual rates, survey horizons -- and served in the official_forecasts array of a predictions response rather than the data array. Which of them publish a given indicator is answered by that array, not by this catalogue, so an indicator with an external_prediction_source_count of 0 may still carry official forecasts.
notes.verified_history: Present only for pairs we have probed end-to-end against production. Its absence means unverified, not unavailable.
